title: Kindness of the Wise Men
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Refusing gifts from strangers is child protection: practise saying no and telling a trusted adult; never frighten (SAFE).

skills.key_step: The child lists the wise men's three gifts and knows to refuse gifts from strangers and tell a trusted adult.

floor.question: Who came to see baby Jesus in the manger?

representations: a role-play: saying no to a stranger
steps: Practise saying no to a stranger's gift.
contexts: a stranger at the school gate

board.say: What did the wise men give?

board.do: Wait for the child to name the gifts.
Write the gifts, then: no to strangers' gifts.

misconceptions.ask: Which gifts did the wise men give Jesus?
misconceptions.repair: Show three boxes labelled with the gifts.

listen_for: Take it, like baby Jesus got gifts
misconceptions.ask: A stranger offers you a gift on the way home. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Separate the story from the rule. Practise "No, thank you" and telling a trusted adult.

misconceptions.ask: How many kinds of gifts did the wise men bring?

misconceptions.repair: Match visitors to what they did.

checks.question: Name a gift of the wise men.
A stranger offers sweets. What do you do?
checks.answer: Say no and tell a trusted adult
